source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		PBP as string,
		ContractNumber as string,
		SegmentNumber as string,
		PaymentDate as string,
		PayAdjStartDate as timestamp,
		PayAdjEndDate as timestamp,
		HICN as string,
		Hospice as string,
		ESRD as string,
		AdjReasonCode as string,
		DefaultRiskFacCode as string,
		RiskAdjFacTypeCode as string,
		RiskAdjFacPrtA as decimal(19,19),
		RiskAdjFacPrtB as decimal(19,19),
		MonPayAdjAmtRateA as decimal(19,19),
		MonPayAdjAmtRateB as decimal(19,19),
		DemPayAdjRatePrtA as string,
		DemPayAdjRatePrtB as string,
		PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt as decimal(19,19),
		PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt as decimal(19,19),
		LISPremSubsidy as decimal(19,19),
		PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt as decimal(19,19),
		PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtACostSharReduc as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtBCostSharReduc as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt as decimal(19,19),
		MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA as decimal(19,19),
		MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB as decimal(19,19),
		TotalPrtAMAPymt as decimal(19,19),
		TotalPrtBMAPymt as decimal(19,19),
		TotalMAPayAmt as decimal(19,19),
		DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode as string,
		PrtDRiskAdjtFacType as string,
		PrtDRAFac as decimal(19,19),
		PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt as decimal(19,19),
		RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc as decimal(19,19),
		PrtDBasicPremAmt as decimal(19,19),
		PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt as decimal(19,19),
		ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt as decimal(19,19),
		LICSSubsidyAmt as decimal(19,19),
		PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt as decimal(19,19),
		PACEPremAddOn as decimal(19,19),
		PACECostSharingAddon as decimal(19,19),
		MTM as decimal(19,19),
		TotalPrtDPymt as decimal(19,19),
		PrtAEntitlement as string,
		PrtBEntitlement as string,
		NewMedicaidStsflag as string,
		MedicaidInd as string,
		MedicaidSts as string,
		MedicaidDualStsCode as string,
		DualPrtDEnrollSts as string,
		LTIFlag as string,
		Inst as string,
		OutofAreaInd as string,
		StateCountyCode as string,
		AgeGroup as string,
		RiskAdjAgeGroup as string,
		AgedDisabledMSP as string,
		ESRDMSPFlag as string,
		MSPFac as string,
		PrtDLowIncomeInd as string,
		PrtDLowIncomeMul as decimal(19,19),
		PrtDLongTermInstInd as string,
		PrtDLongTermInstMul as decimal(19,19),
		EGHPFlag as string,
		OREC as string,
		FrailtyInd as string,
		PrtCFrailtyScoreFac as string,
		LagInd as string,
		EnrollmentSource as string,
		RaceCode as string,
		PreviousDisableRatio as string,
		DeMinimis as string,
		NHC as string,
		PIP_DCG as string,
		CleanupID as string,
		RunDate as timestamp,
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD as string,
		Filler as string,
		Surname as string,
		FirstInitial as string,
		GenderCode as string,
		DateofBirth as date,
		WLP_MED_BU as string,
		WLP_MED_MBU as string,
		WLP_MED_PROD as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		DrugSubsidyAmt as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT COA.WLPBusUnit AS WLP_MED_BU, COA.WLPMedMBU AS WLP_MED_MBU, COA.WLPMedProd AS WLP_MED_PROD, MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR AS ContractNumber, MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AS PBP, MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_SGMNT_ID AS SegmentNumber, MMR.PAYMENT_DT AS PaymentDate, Format(MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT,\'MM/dd/yyyy\') AS PayAdjStartDate, Format(MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT,\'MM/dd/yyyy\') AS PayAdjEndDate, MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AS HICN, CRMR.SBSB_ID AS SBSB_ID, MMR.HOSPICE AS Hospice, MMR.ESRD AS ESRD, MMR.ADJ_REASON_CD AS AdjReasonCode, MMR.DEF_RISK_FAC_CD_PART_C AS DefaultRiskFacCode, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_CD AS RiskAdjFacTypeCode, CONVERT(float,MMR.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_A) AS RiskAdjFacPrtA, CONVERT(float,MMR.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_B) AS RiskAdjFacPrtB, CONVERT(float,MMR.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_A) AS MonPayAdjAmtRateA,  CONVERT(float,MMR.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_B) AS MonPayAdjAmtRateB, \' \' AS DemPayAdjRatePrtA, \' \' AS DemPayAdjRatePrtB, CONVERT(float,MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_A) AS PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_B) AS PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_LOW_INCM_PREM_SBSDY_AMT) AS LISPremSubsidy, CONVERT(float,MMR.BASIC_PART_C_PART_A) AS PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.BASIC_PART_C_PART_B) AS PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_A) AS RbtPrtACostSharReduc, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_B) AS RbtPrtBCostSharReduc, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_A) AS RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_B) AS RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_A) AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_B) AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_A) AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_B) AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_A) AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA, CONVERT(float,MMR.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_B) AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB, CONVERT(float,MMR.TOTAL_MA_PART_A) AS TotalPrtAMAPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.TOTAL_MA_PART_B) AS TotalPrtBMAPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_MDRNZN_ACT_TOTL_PAY_AMT) AS TotalMAPayAmt, MMR.DEF_RISK_FAC_CD_PART_D AS DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_PART_D AS PrtDRiskAdjtFacType, CONVERT(float,MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_PART_D) AS PrtDRAFac, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_PART_D_DRCT_SBSDY_AMT) AS PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_PART_D_PREM_RDCTN_AMT) AS RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc, CONVERT(float,MMR.BASIC_PREM_RED_PART_D) AS PrtDBasicPremAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_D) AS PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_REINSRNC_SBSDY_AMT) AS ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_LOW_INCM_COST_SHRG_AMT) AS LICSSubsidyAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.ORIG_PART_D_CVRG_GAP_DSCNT_AMT) AS PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt, CONVERT(float,MMR.PACE_PREM_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D) AS PACEPremAddOn, CONVERT(float,MMR.PACE_CS_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D) AS PACECostSharingAddon, CONVERT(float,MMR.MTM_AMT) AS MTM, CONVERT(float,MMR.TOTAL_PART_D_PAY) AS TotalPrtDPymt, CONVERT(float,MMR.PRDIB) AS DrugSubsidyAmt, MMR.PART_A_ENTITLEMENT AS PrtAEntitlement, MMR.PART_B_ENTITLEMENT AS PrtBEntitlement, MMR.MEDICAID_STS_NEW_BENIF AS NewMedicaidStsflag, MMR.MEDICAID_ADD_ON_FAC AS MedicaidInd, MMR.MEDICAID_STS AS MedicaidSts, MMR.MEDICAID_DUAL_STS_CD AS MedicaidDualStsCode, \' \' AS DualPrtDEnrollSts, MMR.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_PART_C AS LTIFlag, \' \' AS Inst, MMR.OUT_OF_AREA_IND AS OutofAreaInd, MMR.STATE_COUNTRY_CD AS StateCountyCode, \' \' AS AgeGroup, MMR.RAAG AS RiskAdjAgeGroup, MMR.MSP_AGED_DISABLED AS AgedDisabledMSP, MMR.MSP_ESRD AS ESRDMSPFlag, MMR.MSP_RED_FAC_PART_C AS MSPFac, MMR.LOW_INCOME_MI_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeInd, CONVERT(float,MMR.LOW_INCOME_M_PART_D) AS PrtDLowIncomeMul, MMR.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_PART_D AS PrtDLongTermInstInd, CONVERT(float,MMR.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_M_PART_D) AS PrtDLongTermInstMul, MMR.EGHP_FLAG AS EGHPFlag, MMR.OREC AS OREC, MMR.FRAILTY_IND AS FrailtyInd, MMR.FRAILTY_FAC_PART_C AS PrtCFrailtyScoreFac, \' \'  AS LagInd, \' \'  AS EnrollmentSource, \' \' AS RaceCode, \' \' AS PreviousDisableRatio, \' \' AS DeMinimis, \' \' AS NHC, MMR.PIP_DCG AS PIP_DCG, MMR.CLEANUP_ID AS CleanupID, Format(MMR.CMS_RUN_DT,\'MM/dd/yyyy\') AS RunDate, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_PART_A AS NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_PART_B AS NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_MON_PART_D AS NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD, \' \' AS Filler, MMR.LAST_NM AS Surname, MMR.FRST_INIT_NM AS FirstInitial, MMR.SRC_MBR_GNDR_CD AS GenderCode, Format(MMR.MBR_BRTH_DT,\'MM/dd/yyyy\') AS DateofBirth, CRMR.GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CRMR.CSCS_ID AS CSCS_ID, CRMR.CSPI_ID AS CSPI_ID FROM PSGL.CMS_MMR_RAW MMR JOIN PSGL.MMR_CRMR_LOAD CRMR  ON CRMR.MEME_HICN = MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AND CRMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR  AND CRMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID = MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT BETWEEN CRMR.MEPE_EFF_DT AND CRMR.MEPE_TERM_DT AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT BETWEEN CRMR.MEPE_EFF_DT AND CRMR.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN Finance.COAExcelFinal COA ON CRMR.GRGR_ID=COA.[Group] AND CRMR.CSCS_ID=COA.Class AND CRMR.CSPI_ID=COA.[Plan]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBSQL
SRCOLEDBSQL derive(TotalMAPayAmt = toString(TotalMAPayAmt),
		DrugSubsidyAmt = toDecimal(DrugSubsidyAmt,19,19),
		PayAdjStartDate = toDate(toString(PayAdjStartDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		PayAdjEndDate = toDate(toString(PayAdjEndDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		RunDate = toDate(toString(RunDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
